component.name: Sxarty
component.summary: Read one word at a time, without losing your place

description.p: Sxarty shows a document one word at a time, held at the point your eye already wants to look. Removing the jump between words removes most of the work of reading a line.

Unlike most readers of this kind, you can go back. A context panel shows the text around the word you are on, and clicking any word in it moves the reader there, so half-catching a clause is recoverable instead of gone.
Reads plain text, Markdown, PDF, Word and EPUB files.
Rebuilt interface, a clickable context panel, and correct Georgian rendering.
